sentences.japanese: 苦心惨憺の末、考え出した企画が、会議で一瞬にして却下されちゃうんだからな。
sentences.english: After all the trouble we went to in coming up with that project, it only took them a second to shoot it down in the meeting.

sentences.japanese: 会社の行く末は彼の肩に掛かっていた。
sentences.english: He bore the future of the company on his shoulders.

sentences.japanese: 夏の末と秋には紅葉が見られる。
sentences.english: In late summer and autumn one can see the leaves change colour.

sentences.japanese: 一週間熟考した末に新しい計画を考えついた。
sentences.english: A week's reflection led to a new plan.

sentences.japanese: よく考えた末、私は家にいることに決めた。
sentences.english: After some careful thought, I elected to stay at home.
